lines.t:
The design tolerance of <c:ffff00>legs<c> for bearing the weight
of <c:ffff00>heavy<c> {{part|pl}}.

If you equip more heavy {{part|pl}} than the limit (going
{{over_the_limit}}), the <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> of the legs and the heavy
{{part|pl}} drop.
The more you exceed it, the worse the legs perform:
  Over by 1: <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c> -25%
  Over by 2: -50%; over by 3: -75%
